about: The 24 beginner requests from the plan's eval section, six per kind, English only. Each one runs once with no skill (the baseline) and once with settle.

requests.request: make a switch that feels really nice to click
a like button for my recipe blog, something fun happens when you tap the heart
i need a download button that shows the progress and then says it's done
star rating where you pick 1 to 5 stars, make it satisfying
a dropdown to choose your country but make it smooth like on a mac
tabs for my app settings: profile, billing, notifications. clean and snappy please
show my sales for the last 12 months, make it pop
visitors per day this month, make it look alive
donut chart of where my money went this month: rent 1200, food 450, transport 180, fun 220, savings 300
I want to know whether my token consumption has increased over the past few weeks.
bar chart of how many tickets each person on my team closed this sprint, fancy enough for a presentation
A ring showing how close I am today to typing 10,000 characters.
a good-looking little weather card
a small music player card
pomodoro timer for my study site that i can start, pause and reset
a todo list where i can tick things off and drag them to reorder
An anime watchlist card that shows the next episode of the anime I'm following, the streaming platform, and how much time is left until it airs.

An exercise tracker that uses check-ins to complete each step of the process, from the time of the last workout—having the idea for this workout—preparation—execution—how long the execution lasted—completion.
a short looping animation that shows off my todo app
a short looping animation that shows off my app's buttons
10 second promo animation for my habit tracker app, to post on twitter
animated intro for my landing page showing how my budgeting app works in 3 steps
a looping animation of a chat where a message comes in and someone types a reply, for my website's hero
show a file uploading, getting processed and finishing, as a little animation for my product hunt launch
